values.meaning: Reduced Health Cost when cast under Rejuvenation, as percent of maximum health
values.binNote: No direct data value states this; it is the derived remaining cost = PercentHealthCost (0.1) x (1 - PercentHealthCostRefund [0.8..1]) = [0.02,0.015,0.01,0.005,0], matching the wiki's 2 to 0%.

values.meaning: Health cost as percent of maximum health
Minimum current health required to cast
values.quote: cannot be cast if '''Soraka''' is below {{as|{{sti|5% of her '''maximum''' health}}}}

mechanics.claim: Astral Infusion heals the target allied champion by consuming a portion of Soraka's maximum health.
mechanics.quote: '''Soraka''' consumes a portion of {{as|her '''maximum''' health}} to {{tip|heal}} the target allied champion.

mechanics.claim: If cast while Soraka is under Starcall's Rejuvenation buff, the health cost is reduced by a percentage instead of the flat 10%.
mechanics.quote: If cast while under ''{{ai|Starcall|Soraka|Rejuvenation}}'', the {{as|health cost}} will be reduced by a percentage.

mechanics.claim: Astral Infusion cannot reduce Soraka's health below 1.
mechanics.quote: ''Astral Infusion'' will not reduce '''Soraka's''' health below {{as|1|hp}}.

mechanics.claim: Spirit Visage on the target ally boosts the heal they receive; on Soraka it does not boost the heal Astral Infusion grants to allies (only boosts Starcall and Wish self-heals).
mechanics.quote: {{ii|Spirit Visage}} will only increase the health donated to allies if the target ally possesses it, although owning it ''will'' boost the heal that '''Soraka''' receives from {{ai|Starcall|Soraka}} and {{ai|Wish|Soraka}}

mechanics.claim: Astral Infusion's effects occur before the cast time completes.
mechanics.quote: ''Astral Infusion's'' effects occur before the cast time.
